semantics: Unvalidated local four-class outputs. AI involvement = AI + AI-edited + Humanized; native 1-Human agrees within floating-point rounding. No value is a verified authorship probability or a fraction of words.
comparison_limit: A rise in the Human class or fall in the AI class does not establish improved writing, human origin, or general detection performance. Movement into AI-edited or Humanized remains inside the AI-involvement aggregate.

paragraphs.quote: My warning system was a folded towel on the seat of a loose chair. The chair stayed in the corner of my kitchen for most of the winter. Visitors understood the warning, although I still explained the wobble every time someone came over. I had inherited the chair from my aunt; an awkward joint did not seem reason enough to throw it out.

Last Sunday I finally took it apart. The back came away with one careful pull, though I had expected the old glue to resist. There is a pale patch underneath that might be a repair or just where the finish wore off. I cannot remember whether my aunt ever repaired it herself. I left the patch alone.

The chair is usable now, though one leg still catches slightly on the uneven floor. I moved the towel back to its hook. The afternoon mostly gave me another place to sit. I would like to say it settled something about keeping my aunt's things, but the harder choices are still in the box above the wardrobe.

occlusion.interpretation: Sensitivity to deleting a paragraph. Positive delta means removal lowered the score; length/context changes confound this. This is not causal authorship evidence or a sentence probability.

guard_checks: Successful serialized worker exit, pinned model and weight hashes, exact input hash, complete single-window token coverage, finite four-class outputs/sum, and exact deletion anchors/deltas checked.
